C0288.title: Hangzhou Police Crack First Illegal SMS Bombing Software Case, Two Suspects Detained
C0288.summary: In June 2016, Hangzhou police cracked the first case of illegally manufacturing and selling SMS bombing software, capturing two suspects surnamed Zhong (cousins) in Guangdong. In 2015 Zhong Moujia self-taught programming and built the 'Mad Dog SMS Bomber' software, and in April 2016 Zhong Mouyi joined its promotion and sales. The software infiltrated website backends that send SMS verification codes and repeatedly submitted registration information, sending over 360,000 verification messages to more than 3,000 phone numbers, including 5,200 to a single number. The court found Zhong Moujia's sales exceeded 100,000 yuan and Zhong Mouyi's sales were 4,259 yuan, convicting both of providing intrusion tools for computer information systems with suspended sentences and fines.
